# `know_how`

Something someone may know how to do, held by a mind and asked for by recipes; what must be known first (16 §8.5).

## Fields

Besides these, a definition takes the [keys every definition carries](README.md#keys-every-definition-carries).

- `name` ([text](../values.md#texts), or `null`; optional): What a reader calls it.
- `description` ([text](../values.md#texts), or `null`; optional): What a closer look says.
- `needs` (list of id of a [`know_how`](know_how.md); optional): What must be known before it can be taught.
- `group` (string, or `null`; optional): A free-form heading it is listed under.
